title: DP19845 Measuring Economic Preferences with Behavioral Experiments and Surveys Across the Globe
title_zh: 全球行为实验与调查中的经济偏好测量
title_primary: 全球行为实验与调查中的经济偏好测量
title_secondary: DP19845 Measuring Economic Preferences with Behavioral Experiments and Surveys Across the Globe
authors: Michael Kosfeld, Zahra Sharafi, Maira Sontag Gonzalez, Na Zou
official: 官方在线 2025-01-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Recent work in economics has developed survey-based measures of economic preferences that are “experimentally” or “behaviorally validated.” We scrutinize this approach focusing on the Global Preference Survey (Falk et al., 2018, 2023). Replicating their behavioral validation on almost 2,000 participants in five countries, China, Colombia, Iran, Kenya, and the US, we find that many items correlate significantly with behavior in incentivized choice experiments, but coefficients vary and are not always sizable. While hypothetical versions of an experiment consistently show the strongest correlations, qualitative self-assessments are also almost always among the best single-item modules predicting behavior in all countries. Within- and across-preference principal component analyses, as well as comparison in terms of predictive validity, suggest that qualitative self-assessments and behavioral measures capture distinct dimensions of the same latent construct of an economic preference, casting doubt on the use of one instrument as an easy substitute for the other.
abstract_zh: 近期的经济学研究开发了基于调查的经济偏好测量方法，这些方法经过“实验性”或“行为性”验证。我们审视了这一方法，重点关注全球偏好调查（Falk等人，2018，2023）。通过在中国、哥伦比亚、伊朗、肯尼亚和美国五个国家近2000名参与者中复制其行为验证，我们发现许多条目与激励性选择实验中的行为显著相关，但系数各异且并非总是显著。虽然实验的假设版本始终显示出最强的相关性，但定性自我评估也几乎在所有国家中始终是预测行为的最佳单项模块之一。偏好内和偏好间的主成分分析，以及预测效度的比较表明，定性自我评估和行为测量捕捉了同一经济偏好潜在结构的不同维度，这对使用一种工具作为另一种工具的简单替代提出了质疑。

title: Market Power in Mexican Industries
title_zh: 墨西哥产业中的市场势力
title_primary: 墨西哥产业中的市场势力
title_secondary: Market Power in Mexican Industries
authors: Francisco Arizala & Diana Ricciulli-Marín & Johanna Schauer
official: 官方在线 2026-08-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies market power in Mexican industries over the period 2008-23 using establishment-level data from the Mexican Economic Census. We document a substantial increase in the average price markup over marginal costs, from 12 percent in 2008 to 27 percent in 2023. The sources of this increase vary across sectors and time: services, particularly wholesale and retail trade, account for most of the increase in markups until 2018, while manufacturing, led by transportation equipment and export-oriented industries, plays a larger role in more recent years. Rising markups in services are associated with greater local labor market concentration, suggestive of increasing monopsony power. In manufacturing, markup growth is linked to higher capital expenditure, consistent with firms sustaining larger markups to recover higher fixed costs. Moreover, rising markups in manufacturing are positively associated with total factor productivity, whereas in services they are uncorrelated with productivity. Overall, these findings suggest that while market power has increased over time, its underlying drivers have shifted from monopsonistic power in labor markets to higher fixed costs, with more favorable efficiency implications in recent years.
abstract_zh: 本文利用墨西哥经济普查的企业层面数据，研究了2008年至2023年间墨西哥行业的市场势力。我们记录了平均价格加成率相对于边际成本的显著上升，从2008年的12%增至2023年的27%。这一增长的来源在不同部门和时间段有所差异：服务业，尤其是批发和零售贸易，在2018年前贡献了加成率增长的大部分；而制造业，以运输设备和出口导向型行业为主导，在近年发挥了更大作用。服务业加成率的上升与地方劳动力市场集中度的提高相关，暗示着买方垄断势力的增强。在制造业中，加成率的增长与更高的资本支出相关联，这与企业维持较大加成率以回收更高固定成本的现象一致。此外，制造业中加成率的上升与全要素生产率呈正相关，而在服务业中则与生产率无相关性。总体而言，这些发现表明，尽管市场势力随时间增强，其潜在驱动因素已从劳动力市场的买方垄断势力转向更高的固定成本，且近年来的效率影响更为有利。

title: Equilibrium selection in a class of aggregative games under sampling dynamics
title_zh: 一类聚合博弈在抽样动态下的均衡选择
title_primary: 一类聚合博弈在抽样动态下的均衡选择
title_secondary: Equilibrium selection in a class of aggregative games under sampling dynamics
authors: A. Arun, Ratul Lahkar, Souvik Roy
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider a large population aggregative game with strategic complementarities. The game has multiple Nash equilibria, which can be Pareto ranked. We apply the k − sampling best response dynamic to this game. This dynamic is generated when agents best respond to the strategies of k randomly sampled opponents. We establish conditions under which the Pareto efficient equilibrium is almost globally asymptotically stable under this dynamic. Results depend upon the relationship between benefits and costs in the game and the sample size.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个具有策略互补性的大规模总体聚合博弈。该博弈存在多个纳什均衡，且这些均衡可按帕累托排序。我们将k-抽样最优反应动态应用于此博弈。该动态产生于当参与者对随机抽取的k个对手的策略作出最优反应时。我们建立了在此动态下帕累托有效均衡几乎全局渐近稳定的条件。结果取决于博弈中的收益与成本关系以及样本大小。

title: The biodiversity impacts of forestry and agricultural land grabs on Indigenous Peoples’ Lands
title_zh: 林业与农业土地掠夺对原住民土地生物多样性的影响
title_primary: 林业与农业土地掠夺对原住民土地生物多样性的影响
title_secondary: The biodiversity impacts of forestry and agricultural land grabs on Indigenous Peoples’ Lands
authors: Jacqueline Choo, Luis R. Carrasco, David P. Edwards
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Indigenous Peoples' Lands (IPLs) play a key role in biodiversity conservation, yet IPLs are vulnerable to land grabbing for agricultural development. To understand the potential habitat exposure and main commodities overlapping with land grabs on IPLs, we combined the spatial distribution of land grabs intended for agricultural crops, plantations, and logging on IPLs with biodiversity metrics for mammal and bird species. Globally, 9.4 Mha of land grabs were on IPLs, with Russia (4.5 Mha), Myanmar (0.7 Mha), and Indonesia (0.7 Mha) having the highest areas. Land grabs were mainly for logging in Russia, biofuels in Myanmar, and a mixture of non-food, food, and biofuel crops in Indonesia. Oil palm (39 kha) and rice (37 kha) were the food crops and oil palm (42 kha) the biofuel crop associated with the highest deforestation areas on grabbed IPLs, while it was rubber (6 kha) for non-food crops. Deforestation on grabbed IPLs overlapped with 3213 species ranges with the highest potential habitat exposure in Indonesia, Malaysia, and Vietnam, on land grabs intended for oil palm, rubber crops, and timber plantations. Our results show that there are substantial land grabs on IPLs with a considerable potential habitat exposure, hence more effort is needed to protect IPL rights, ensuring indigenous stewardship of their land and biodiversity conservation.
abstract_zh: 原住民土地（IPLs）在生物多样性保护中扮演着关键角色，然而这些土地却易受农业开发导致的土地掠夺影响。为探究IPLs上土地掠夺的潜在栖息地暴露及其主要商品重叠情况，我们结合了针对农业作物、种植园和伐木活动的土地掠夺空间分布，以及哺乳动物和鸟类物种的生物多样性指标。全球范围内，IPLs上共有940万公顷的土地被掠夺，其中俄罗斯（450万公顷）、缅甸（70万公顷）和印度尼西亚（70万公顷）面积最大。土地掠夺主要用于俄罗斯的伐木、缅甸的生物燃料，以及印度尼西亚的非粮食作物、粮食作物和生物燃料作物的混合用途。油棕（3.9万公顷）和水稻（3.7万公顷）是与被掠夺IPLs上森林砍伐面积最大的粮食作物，而油棕（4.2万公顷）则是与森林砍伐面积最大的生物燃料作物，橡胶（0.6万公顷）为非粮食作物。被掠夺IPLs上的森林砍伐与3213个物种的分布范围重叠，其中印度尼西亚、马来西亚和越南的潜在栖息地暴露程度最高，主要涉及油棕、橡胶作物和木材种植园的土地掠夺。我们的研究结果表明，IPLs上存在大量土地掠夺，且具有显著的潜在栖息地暴露，因此需要加大力度保护原住民土地权利，确保原住民对其土地的管理权及生物多样性保护。

title: Firms as Electoral Monopsonies
title_zh: 企业作为选举中的垄断买方
title_primary: 企业作为选举中的垄断买方
title_secondary: Firms as Electoral Monopsonies
authors: Carlos Fernando Avenancio-León, Adelina Barbalau, Cyndi Hou, Alessio Piccolo
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how dominant employers can act as *electoral monopsonies*, using local labor market power to shape political preferences and electoral outcomes. We first present original survey evidence showing that workers at major local employers are more likely to experience employer political communication and to report that their employers influence their voting behavior and career expectations. We then develop a model in which a dominant employer can affect voters’ preferences by shaping their expectations about how wages and employment depend on electoral outcomes. We distinguish a passive channel, through which workers internalize firms’ economic interests, from an active channel, through which dominant employers strategically influence these expectations. Under the active channel, labor market power translates into political power and can generate political failures by inducing voters to oppose policies they would otherwise support. The model also shows how electoral monopsonies can contribute to political polarization, constrain political platforms, and substitute for campaign spending. Using U.S. individual-level voting data and a shift-share design based on national industry concentration shocks and predetermined local employment shares, we show that greater electoral monopsony power increases Republican voter turnout. Counterfactual estimates imply that reducing electoral monopsony power could have narrowly changed the outcomes of the 2016 and 2024 presidential elections.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了主导雇主如何充当“选举性买方垄断者”，利用本地劳动力市场力量来塑造政治偏好和选举结果。我们首先呈现原始调查证据，表明大型本地雇主的工人更可能经历雇主的政治沟通，并报告其雇主影响他们的投票行为和职业期望。接着，我们构建了一个模型，在该模型中，主导雇主可以通过塑造工人对工资和就业如何取决于选举结果的预期来影响选民偏好。我们区分了被动渠道——工人内化企业的经济利益，与主动渠道——主导雇主战略性地影响这些预期。在主动渠道下，劳动力市场力量转化为政治力量，并可能通过诱导选民反对他们原本会支持的政策而导致政治失灵。该模型还展示了选举性买方垄断如何加剧政治极化、限制政治纲领，并替代竞选支出。利用美国个体层面的投票数据以及基于全国行业集中度冲击和预定地方就业份额的转移份额设计，我们证明更大的选举性买方垄断力量会增加共和党选民的投票率。反事实估计表明，减少选举性买方垄断力量可能以微弱优势改变2016年和2024年总统选举的结果。

title: Rethinking Short-Term Real Interest Rates and Term Spreads Using Very Long-Run Data
title_zh: 基于超长期数据重新审视短期实际利率与期限利差
title_primary: 基于超长期数据重新审视短期实际利率与期限利差
title_secondary: Rethinking Short-Term Real Interest Rates and Term Spreads Using Very Long-Run Data
authors: Kenneth Rogoff, Barbara Rossi, Paul Schmelzing
official: 官方在线 2025-10-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Utilizing critical recent data advances, we analyze empirical evidence on long-run samples of shortmaturity real interest rates as well as term spreads based on multi-century data.In contrast to an extensive literature on short-maturity real interest rates over the past few decades, we find strong and consistent evidence of trend stationarity in long horizon series, relatively fast adjustment speeds, and a paucity of structural breaks -results that we show to survive out of sample tests.The use of very long-run data offers a fresh perspective for ongoing monetary policy debates surrounding r*, and also provides a crucial missing link to reconstructing the long-run properties of term spreads.On balance and against limited post-COVID data, our evidence suggests caution on the idea of a break in short-term real interest rate behavior and instead points to elements of continuity over very long time periods.Relatedly, we show that term spreads are secularly rising while inflation volatility trends in the exact opposite direction -a finding questioning the emphasis of influential term structure models.
abstract_zh: 利用近期关键数据进展，我们基于多世纪数据，对短期实际利率的长期样本及期限利差进行了实证分析。与过去几十年来关于短期实际利率的大量文献不同，我们发现长期时间序列中存在强烈且一致的趋势平稳性证据，调整速度相对较快，且结构性断裂较少——这些结果在样本外测试中依然稳健。利用超长期数据为围绕r*的现行货币政策辩论提供了新视角，同时也为重构期限利差的长期特性提供了关键缺失环节。总体而言，面对有限的疫情后数据，我们的证据提示应对短期实际利率行为发生断裂的观点持谨慎态度，反而指向了极长时间跨度上的连续性要素。相关地，我们显示期限利差呈长期上升趋势，而通胀波动性趋势则完全相反——这一发现对具有影响力的期限结构模型的侧重点提出了质疑。

title: Health Care Reform and Firm Dynamics: Evidence from Medicare Part D and the Retail Pharmacy Industry
title_zh: 医疗改革与企业动态：来自Medicare D部分与零售药店行业的证据
title_primary: 医疗改革与企业动态：来自Medicare D部分与零售药店行业的证据
title_secondary: Health Care Reform and Firm Dynamics: Evidence from Medicare Part D and the Retail Pharmacy Industry
authors: Churchill, Brandyn, Cisneros, Georgina, Marquardt, Kelli R., Churchill, Brandyn F.
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Health care reforms are often enacted before implementation, creating uncertainty that can shape firms’ decisions. We examine how Medicare Part D affected the retail pharmacy industry using 2000-2009 establishment-level data, leveraging the fact that Part D disproportionately affected counties with larger elderly populations. Consistent with predictions from a conceptual model in which pre-implementation uncertainty discourages entry and lower post-implementation margins prevent full recovery, we find that Part D was associated with a 5-percent reduction in pharmacies, driven by fewer openings rather than more closures. We also find suggestive evidence that reduced pharmacy access dampened Part D’s mortality benefits.
abstract_zh: 医疗改革常常在实施前就已颁布，由此产生的不确定性可能影响企业的决策。我们利用2000-2009年机构层面的数据，考察了医疗保险D部分如何影响零售药店行业，并利用D部分对老年人口比例较高的县影响更大的事实。与概念模型的预测一致——该模型认为实施前的不确定性抑制了市场进入，而实施后较低的利润率阻碍了完全恢复——我们发现D部分与药店数量减少5%相关，这一减少主要由新开药店数量下降而非关闭数量增加所致。我们还发现了初步证据表明，药店可及性的降低削弱了D部分在降低死亡率方面的益处。

title: Weak Identification in Low-Dimensional Factor Models with One or Two Factors
title_zh: 一或两个因子低维因子模型中的弱识别问题
title_primary: 一或两个因子低维因子模型中的弱识别问题
title_secondary: Weak Identification in Low-Dimensional Factor Models with One or Two Factors
authors: Gregory Fletcher Cox
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper describes how to reparametrize low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors to fit weak identification theory developed for generalized method of moments models. Some identification-robust tests, here called “plug-in” tests, require a reparametrization to distinguish weakly identified parameters from strongly identified parameters. The reparametrizations in this paper make plug-in tests available for subvector hypotheses in low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors. Simulations show that the plug-in tests are less conservative than identification-robust tests that use the original parametrization. An empirical application to a factor model of parental investments in children is included.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述了如何对含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型进行重新参数化，以适配为广义矩估计模型开发的弱识别理论。部分识别稳健性检验（此处称为"插件式"检验）需要通过重新参数化来区分弱识别参数与强识别参数。本文提出的重新参数化方法使得插件式检验能够应用于含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型中的子向量假设。模拟结果表明，相较于使用原始参数化的识别稳健性检验，插件式检验的保守性更低。文中还包含一个关于父母对子女投资因子模型的实证应用案例。

title: Market Power in the Securities Lending Market*
title_zh: 证券借贷市场中的市场势力
title_primary: 证券借贷市场中的市场势力
title_secondary: Market Power in the Securities Lending Market*
authors: shuaiyu chen, Ron Kaniel, Christian Opp
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We document market power in U.S. equity securities lending and examine its origins and consequences. We develop a dynamic model of securities lending and estimate it on the cross-section of U.S. equities, showing that the dominant custodian-intermediated market structure emerges as a response to short sellers’ information-leakage concerns. Short sellers prefer this opaque market structure over a centralized alternative, particularly for smaller stocks, despite the associated non-competitive fees. This is because their trading strategies become unprofitable if information leaks prematurely. Thus, unlike in standard product markets, the demand side in securities lending values opacity, which is important for regulatory design.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了美国股票证券借贷中的市场势力，并考察了其起源与后果。我们构建了一个证券借贷的动态模型，并基于美国股票截面数据进行了估计，结果表明，以托管机构为中介的主导型市场结构是对卖空者信息泄露担忧的回应。尽管这种不透明的市场结构伴随着非竞争性费用，但卖空者仍偏好于此，而非集中化替代方案，尤其是对于小盘股而言。这是因为，如果信息过早泄露，他们的交易策略将无利可图。因此，与标准产品市场不同，证券借贷的需求方看重不透明性，这对监管设计具有重要意义。

abstract: Credence goods markets are prone to fraudulent behavior and market inefficiencies due to informational asymmetries between sellers and customers. We examine experimentally the effects of diagnostic uncertainty and insurance coverage on the information acquisition and provision decisions by sellers and the trading decisions by consumers. Our results reveal that diagnostic uncertainty is a major source of inefficiency that decreases efficient service provision. Insurance coverage has a positive net effect on market efficiency, despite making information acquisition and efficient service provision less likely.
abstract_zh: 信任品市场因卖方与顾客之间的信息不对称，易发生欺诈行为并导致市场效率低下。我们通过实验考察了诊断不确定性和保险覆盖对卖方信息获取与提供决策以及消费者交易决策的影响。结果显示，诊断不确定性是导致效率下降的主要来源，它减少了高效服务的提供。尽管保险覆盖降低了信息获取和高效服务提供的可能性，但其对市场效率具有正向净效应。

abstract: In the aftermath of the Russian invasion in Ukraine and rising gas prices, the ’gas price brake’, a subsidy scheme for retail consumers and firms, was implemented in Germany. We employ a difference-in-differences approach and analyze data on offered gas contracts from two countries with comparable gas markets, where one country (Germany) has implemented the gas price brake and the other (Austria) has not. We find that the gas price brake led to an increase in total annual gas costs in Germany. This increase is entirely attributable to incumbents increasing counterfactual gas prices by up to 90%. Non-incumbents do not ’milk‘ the brake.

title: Immigrants’ social identity, racial hate crimes, and public backlash: Evidence from the ”San Gennaro massacre”
title_zh: 移民社会身份、种族仇恨犯罪与公众反弹：来自“圣热纳罗大屠杀”的证据
title_primary: 移民社会身份、种族仇恨犯罪与公众反弹：来自“圣热纳罗大屠杀”的证据

authors: Maria Rosaria Carillo, Tiziana Venittelli, Alberto Zazzaro
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how racial hate crimes influence immigrants’ social identity and sense of belonging to the host country. We focus on the 2008 “San Gennaro massacre”, an attack by a Camorra clan against African immigrants in Southern Italy. Using a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach, we show that the event increased the sense of belonging to Italy among Africans living in the affected area, driven by both a ”fear effect” and a ”solidarity effect”. We further document that this shift in social identification spread to other African immigrant communities, particularly those residing in municipalities characterized by a strong presence of organized crime and by a strong local public reaction of solidarity. Finally, we find that this increase in identification with Italy is persistent over time and is not associated with a weakening of ethnic identity.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了种族仇恨犯罪如何影响移民的社会认同感及对东道国的归属感。我们聚焦于2008年的“圣真纳罗大屠杀”，这是一起卡莫拉犯罪家族对意大利南部非洲移民发动的袭击。采用双重差分法（DiD），我们表明该事件增强了受影响地区非洲裔居民对意大利的归属感，这一效应由“恐惧效应”和“团结效应”共同驱动。我们进一步记录到，这种社会认同的转变扩散到了其他非洲移民社区，尤其是那些居住在组织犯罪活动猖獗且当地公众团结反应强烈的市镇的社区。最后，我们发现这种对意大利认同感的增强随时间持续存在，且并未伴随族裔认同的减弱。

title: How does public data openness enhance urban total factor productivity? A perspective from government governance and transaction costs
title_zh: 公共数据开放如何提升城市全要素生产率？——基于政府治理与交易成本的视角
title_primary: 公共数据开放如何提升城市全要素生产率？——基于政府治理与交易成本的视角
title_secondary: How does public data openness enhance urban total factor productivity? A perspective from government governance and transaction costs
authors: Fengxia Hao, Junhao Qiu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study evaluates the causal effect of public data openness on urban total factor productivity (TFP) and explores its mechanisms through government governance and transaction costs. Using panel data of Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2000 to 2023, we treat the launch of government data open platforms as a quasi-natural experiment and employ a multi-period difference-in-differences (DID) approach. TFP is measured via the two-step Solow residual method, with robustness verified by instrumental variable estimation, PSM-DID, placebo tests, and green TFP. Baseline regressions show that public data openness significantly enhances urban TFP. Mechanism analysis reveals that improved government governance and reduced transaction costs are the primary drivers. Heterogeneity analysis indicates stronger policy effects in non-Yangtze River Economic Belt regions and areas with lower financial development, exhibiting a ‘timely assistance’ characteristic. This study provides city-level causal evidence, identifies concrete transmission channels, expands research on data factor economic value, and offers empirical support for differentiated data openness policies and inclusive growth.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了公共数据开放对城市全要素生产率（TFP）的因果效应，并探讨其通过政府治理与交易成本的作用机制。利用2000至2023年中国地级市面板数据，我们将政府数据开放平台的上线视为准自然实验，采用多期双重差分（DID）方法进行分析。TFP通过两步索洛残差法测算，并通过工具变量估计、PSM-DID、安慰剂检验及绿色TFP进行稳健性验证。基准回归结果显示，公共数据开放显著提升了城市全要素生产率。机制分析表明，政府治理改善与交易成本降低是主要驱动因素。异质性分析显示，在非长江经济带区域及金融发展水平较低地区，政策效应更为显著，呈现出“雪中送炭”的特征。本研究提供了城市层面的因果证据，识别了具体传导渠道，拓展了数据要素经济价值的研究，并为差异化数据开放政策及包容性增长提供了实证支持。

title: A Behavioral Explanation for the Puzzling Persistence of the Aggregate Real Exchange Rate
title_zh: 实际汇率持续之谜的行为解释
title_primary: 实际汇率持续之谜的行为解释
title_secondary: A Behavioral Explanation for the Puzzling Persistence of the Aggregate Real Exchange Rate
authors: Mario J Crucini, Mototsugu Shintani, Takayuki Tsuruga
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: At the aggregate level, the observation that deviations from purchasing power parity (PPP) are too persistent to be accounted for solely by nominal rigidities has long been a puzzle (Rogoff 1996). In addition, microeconomic evidence suggests that deviations from the law of one price (LOP) are less persistent than PPP deviations. To reconcile these two empirical anomalies, we incorporate the behavioral inattention approach of Gabaix (2014) into a two-country sticky-price model. Our model shows that firms’ behavioral inattention to the aggregate component of real marginal costs generates an endogenous dependence of LOP deviations on PPP deviations. We find strong supporting evidence for this particular formulation of behavioral inattention. Calibrating our model with the estimated degree of attention, we show that our model can fully account for the two empirical anomalies. PPP deviations are more than twice as persistent as those implied by nominal rigidities alone, while the persistence of LOP deviations is about two-thirds that of PPP deviations.
abstract_zh: 在总体层面，购买力平价偏离的持续性远超名义刚性所能解释的范围，这一现象长期以来被视为一个谜题（Rogoff 1996）。此外，微观经济证据表明，一价定律偏离的持续性低于购买力平价偏离。为调和这两个实证异常，我们将Gabaix（2014）的行为疏忽方法引入两国粘性价格模型。模型表明，企业对实际边际成本中总体成分的行为疏忽，会内生地导致一价定律偏离对购买力平价偏离的依赖。我们找到了支持这一特定行为疏忽公式的有力证据。通过使用估计的注意力程度校准模型，我们证明该模型能够完全解释这两个实证异常：购买力平价偏离的持续性比仅由名义刚性所隐含的持续性高出两倍以上，而一价定律偏离的持续性约为购买力平价偏离的三分之二。

title: Public information and coordination with a divided majority
title_zh: 公共信息与分裂多数下的协调
title_primary: 公共信息与分裂多数下的协调
title_secondary: Public information and coordination with a divided majority
authors: Caleb A. Cox, Angela de Oliveira, Brock Stoddard
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Groups often agree that change is needed, but differing preferences and information may still lead to difficulty coordinating on a particular alternative. In a laboratory experiment, we study coordination and information aggregation in a divided-majority voting game with public information and conflicting preferences. Voters observe private signals and a public signal about whether alternative upper A $A$ A or upper B $B$ B is socially optimal. Unless sufficiently many voters agree, an inferior default upper C $C$ C occurs. When the public signal is more accurate than the private signal and voters have common preferences, most voters coordinate on the public signal. However, when public-signal accuracy is reduced or preferences conflict, voters follow the public signal less frequently. While reduced public-signal accuracy substantially increases the frequency of coordination failure, conflicting preferences between subgroups do not. These results highlight the importance of accurate public information in achieving collective action.
abstract_zh: 群体通常认同变革的必要性，但不同的偏好和信息仍可能导致难以就某一特定替代方案达成协调。通过一项实验室实验，我们研究了在存在公共信息和偏好冲突的分裂多数投票博弈中的协调与信息聚合问题。投票者观察私人信号以及关于替代方案A或B何者更优的公共信号。除非有足够多的投票者达成一致，否则将出现较差的默认方案C。当公共信号比私人信号更准确且投票者具有共同偏好时，多数投票者会依据公共信号进行协调。然而，当公共信号准确性降低或偏好存在冲突时，投票者遵循公共信号的频率会下降。尽管公共信号准确性降低会显著增加协调失败的发生频率，但子群体间的偏好冲突并不会产生同样影响。这些结果凸显了准确公共信息在实现集体行动中的重要性。

title: Cash Heterogeneity and the Payout Channel of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 现金异质性与货币政策的支付渠道

authors: ALTAN PAZARBAŞI
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper provides novel empirical evidence that cash‐rich firms have higher equity payouts and higher stock prices in response to expansionary monetary policy surprises. Stock prices rise despite weak cash‐flow, investment, and credit responses to monetary policy. I rationalize the empirical evidence in a heterogeneous‐firm New Keynesian model where firms finance investment with cash and equity issuance. Monetary easing weakens precautionary cash demand, leading cash‐rich firms to optimally allocate excess funds to shareholders. Since payouts are procyclical, cash‐rich firms earn higher returns in expansionary periods. My findings highlight a payout channel through which monetary policy impacts asset prices.
abstract_zh: 本文提供了新颖的经验证据，表明在扩张性货币政策冲击下，现金充裕的企业具有更高的股权支付率和更高的股票价格。尽管现金流、投资和信贷对货币政策的反应较弱，股票价格仍出现上涨。我在一个异质性企业新凯恩斯模型中合理化这一经验证据，该模型中企业通过现金和股权发行来为投资融资。货币宽松削弱了预防性现金需求，导致现金充裕的企业将多余资金最优地分配给股东。由于支付具有顺周期性，现金充裕的企业在扩张期获得更高回报。我的发现揭示了货币政策影响资产价格的一个支付渠道。

title: Remote investing in Latin America, 1869–1929
title_zh: 1869-1929年拉丁美洲的远程投资

authors: Gareth Campbell, Áine Gallagher, Richard S. Grossman
official: 官方在线 2026-05-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Substantial amounts of British capital flowed to Latin America during the first era of globalization. Companies financed by this capital were typically headquartered in the United Kingdom, but operated thousands of miles away. This paper asks how this geographic separation between governance and business activities affected the valuation of these firms. We show that companies headquartered in London and operating in Latin America did not outperform British companies, but were riskier. We find that the location of the headquarters played a more important role than the location of operations. Stock prices tended to fluctuate in line with other equities based in the United Kingdom, suggesting that they were still regarded as being, at least partially, British companies.
abstract_zh: 在第一次全球化时期，大量英国资本流入拉丁美洲。由这些资本资助的公司通常总部设在英国，但运营地点却在数千英里之外。本文探讨了这种治理与商业活动之间的地理分离如何影响这些公司的估值。我们发现，总部设在伦敦并在拉丁美洲运营的公司并未优于英国本土公司，但风险更高。研究结果表明，总部所在地比运营地点更为重要。这些公司的股价往往与英国其他股票同步波动，表明它们仍被视为至少部分属于英国公司。

abstract: Housework is central to feminist calls for recognition of women's work, economic histories explaining the sexual division of labour, and claims regarding the progressive role of scientific knowledge. Yet little is known about the time it actually took. We address this lacuna. We utilize British sources and find a substantial increase in the hours ordinary women spent on domestic labour between the late‐eighteenth and the mid‐twentieth centuries. We note the changing imperatives of state involvement and industrial development and explore how the additional domestic labour served the interests of state and employers as well as those of husbands and children.
abstract_zh: 家务劳动是女性主义呼吁承认女性工作、经济史解释性别劳动分工以及主张科学知识进步作用的核心议题。然而，关于家务劳动实际耗费的时间，我们知之甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白。我们利用英国史料发现，从18世纪末到20世纪中期，普通女性从事家务劳动的时间大幅增加。我们注意到国家干预与工业发展的不断变化的必要性，并探讨了额外家务劳动如何服务于国家、雇主以及丈夫和子女的利益。

title: Firm-Level Labor Shortage Exposure
title_zh: 企业层面劳动力短缺暴露度
title_primary: 企业层面劳动力短缺暴露度

authors: Jarrad Harford, Qiyang He, Buhui Qiu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We extract information from earnings call transcripts to develop a comprehensive and reliable measure of labor shortage exposure. After validating the measure at the state, industry, and firm levels, we show that firms with labor shortage exposures experience lower earnings call CARs, future stock returns and operating performance. Firms respond to labor shortages by substituting labor with capital and R&D investments, and by producing more production-process patents. Such responses help mitigate the negative effects on future performance. Our measure has broad applicability, and our findings provide new insight into labor-capital substitution in imperfectly competitive labor markets.
abstract_zh: 我们从财报电话会议记录中提取信息，构建了一个全面且可靠的劳动力短缺暴露度指标。在州、行业和企业层面验证该指标后，我们发现，面临劳动力短缺暴露的企业，其财报电话会议期间的累计异常收益率（CARs）、未来股票回报率及经营业绩均较低。企业通过以资本和研发投资替代劳动力，并增加生产流程专利的产出，来应对劳动力短缺。这些应对措施有助于缓解对未来业绩的负面影响。我们的指标具有广泛适用性，研究结果为不完全竞争劳动力市场中的劳动-资本替代提供了新见解。

title: Spillovers through Multimarket Firms: The Uniform Product Replacement Channel

abstract: We study how regional housing market disruptions spill over across US local markets through multimarket firm networks. Using granular barcode-level data linked to producer information, we exploit variation in firms’ exposure to local house price declines. A firm’s local sales respond more strongly to indirect housing price declines in its other markets than to direct local declines. The barcode-level data reveal a novel uniform product replacement mechanism: Firms respond to adverse shocks by replacing higher-value products with lower-value alternatives uniformly across all markets. This propagates regional demand shocks through the supply side, with new implications for regional economics.
abstract_zh: 本文研究区域住房市场冲击如何通过跨市场企业网络在美国地方市场间传导。利用与生产者信息相关联的细粒度条形码级数据，我们考察了企业对当地房价下跌的暴露程度差异。研究发现，企业在其其他市场面临的间接房价下跌对其本地销售的影响，比直接本地房价下跌更为显著。条形码级数据揭示了一种新颖的统一产品替代机制：企业通过在所有市场中统一用低价值产品替代高价值产品来应对不利冲击。这一机制通过供给侧将区域需求冲击进行传导，为区域经济学提供了新的启示。

title: Banking with Inside Money: An Efficiency Analysis

abstract: We show that banks do not decentralize the first best in a nominal Diamond–Dybvig economy with inside money. Furthermore, state‐contingent deposit contracts do not expand the consumption possibility set to include the first best either. Central banks can improve welfare but only for savers and only with unconventional monetary policy. Finally, central banks could prevent runs using their lender‐of‐last‐resort facility. These results suggest that, without an explicit incorporation of inside money, it is not trivial to provide a theoretical argument about the ability of the banking sector to efficiently supply liquidity in our economies.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，在包含内部货币的名义Diamond–Dybvig经济中，银行无法实现最优分散化配置。此外，状态依存的存款合约也无法将消费可能性集合扩展至包含最优结果。中央银行虽能提升福利，但仅限于储蓄者，且需借助非常规货币政策。最后，中央银行可通过其最后贷款人机制来防止挤兑。这些结果表明，若不明确纳入内部货币，则难以就银行部门在我们经济中有效提供流动性的能力给出理论论证。

authors: Aiday Sikhova, Sven Oskarsson, Rafael Ahlskog
official: 官方在线 2026-03-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Economists have long studied how parental behavior shapes within-family inequality, yet empirical findings remain mixed. Using twins data from China and Sweden, we examine the predominant mechanisms reported in the literature. Parents in both countries invest similarly during childhood. Inter vivos transfers, however, differ: Chinese parents reinforce income inequality, whereas Swedish parents distribute wealth equally; the reinforcing pattern reflects exchange motives. Bequests are divided equally in both countries. Parental education plays a key role: less educated parents reinforce income inequality, whereas more educated parents transfer wealth equally. Cross-country differences in parental education may thus help explain the mixed findings.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期研究父母行为如何塑造家庭内部不平等，但实证结果仍不一致。利用中国和瑞典的双胞胎数据，我们考察了文献中报告的主要机制。两国的父母在子女童年时期的投资相似。然而，生前转移存在差异：中国父母加剧收入不平等，而瑞典父母则平均分配财富；这种加剧模式反映了交换动机。两国在遗产分配上均采取均分方式。父母教育水平起着关键作用：教育程度较低的父母加剧收入不平等，而教育程度较高的父母则平均转移财富。因此，跨国父母教育差异可能有助于解释这些不一致的研究发现。

title: Counting steps for re-stabilization in a matching market with fixed population
title_zh: 固定人口匹配市场中重新稳定化的步数计算
title_primary: 固定人口匹配市场中重新稳定化的步数计算
title_secondary: Counting steps for re-stabilization in a matching market with fixed population
authors: Agustín G. Bonifacio, Nadia Guiñazú, Noelia Juarez, Pablo Neme, Jorge Oviedo
official: 官方在线 2026-02-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a one-to-one matching market where the population is fixed. If some exogenous reason disrupts a worker-firm pair in a stable matching, can equilibrium in the market be restored? We present an algorithm that models this situation as a re-stabilization process involving a vacancy chain. Each step of the algorithm is a link of such a chain. We show that the length of this vacancy chain is intimately connected with the lattice structure of the set of stable matchings of the market. Namely, this length can be computed by considering the cardinalities of cycles in preferences derived from the initial and final stable matchings involved.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一个固定人口的一对一匹配市场。若某种外生原因破坏了稳定匹配中的一对工人-企业组合，市场均衡能否得以恢复？我们提出一种算法，将此情形建模为涉及空缺链的再稳定化过程。算法的每一步即为此链的一个环节。我们证明，该空缺链的长度与市场稳定匹配集合的格结构密切相关。具体而言，此长度可通过考虑由所涉及的初始和最终稳定匹配推导出的偏好中循环的基数来计算。

title: Land Property Rights and Household Welfare: Evidence from Rural China
title_zh: 土地产权与家庭福利：来自中国农村的证据
title_primary: 土地产权与家庭福利：来自中国农村的证据
title_secondary: Land Property Rights and Household Welfare: Evidence from Rural China
authors: Han Li, Goytom Abraha Kahsay, Wusheng Yu, Hao Xia
official: 官方在线 2025-12-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of land property rights on rural household welfare and resilience outcomes by using large panel data on the rollout of China’s large-scale land certification program. While the program increases households’ consumption, income, assets, and resilience scores, we find no effects on health outcome (proxied by household expenditure on health and self-reported physical health of the household head). Our heterogeneity analysis suggests that the program increases household consumption and resilience across both male- and female-headed households as well as poor and nonpoor households. We identify agricultural investments, access to credit, land rental market participation, and labor allocation as potential mechanisms through which the land certification program affects household welfare and resilience outcomes. Our findings suggest that land property rights reform could be another effective strategy to alleviate poverty in line with the poverty trap hypothesis.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国大规模土地确权项目推行的面板数据，研究了土地产权对农村家庭福利和韧性结果的影响。尽管该项目增加了家庭的消费、收入、资产和韧性评分，但我们发现其对健康结果（以家庭医疗支出和户主自报身体健康状况为代理指标）没有影响。异质性分析表明，该项目提高了男性和女性户主家庭以及贫困和非贫困家庭的消费和韧性。我们识别出农业投资、信贷获取、土地租赁市场参与和劳动力配置是土地确权项目影响家庭福利和韧性结果的潜在机制。我们的研究结果表明，土地产权改革可能是另一种符合贫困陷阱假说的有效减贫策略。

title: Will informal environmental regulation become a new incentive to reduce corporate ESG greenwashing? Empirical evidence from public environmental concerns
title_zh: 非正式环境规制能否成为抑制企业ESG漂绿的新激励？来自公众环境关注的实证证据
title_primary: 非正式环境规制能否成为抑制企业ESG漂绿的新激励？来自公众环境关注的实证证据
title_secondary: Will informal environmental regulation become a new incentive to reduce corporate ESG greenwashing? Empirical evidence from public environmental concerns
authors: Zelin Yuan Jia Chen Baoliu Liu Yujie Huang Mingyu Shu a School of Finance and Accounting, Fuzhou University of International Studies and Trade, Fuzhou, Chinab School of Economics, University of International Business and Economics, Beijing, Chinac School of Economics and Management 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The effect of environmental regulations on corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance and greenwashing behaviour has become the focus of academic attention. This research empirically analyzes the influence of public environmental concern on the ESG performance and greenwashing behaviour of listed companies from the perspective of informal regulations based on the panel data of A-share listed companies from 2007 to 2022. Results show that public environmental concern significantly improves corporate ESG performance, and the conclusion still holds after robustness tests of one period lag, systematic generalized method of moments, and two-stage least squares regression. Heterogeneity analysis shows that public environmental concern has a significantly positive effect on the ESG performance of state-owned enterprises, non-heavily polluting enterprises, and technology-intensive enterprises but a significantly negative effect on the ESG performance of labour-intensive enterprises. Further moderating effect results indicate that government governance and market constraints strengthen the positive effect of public environmental concern on firms’ ESG performance. Finally, this study confirms that public environmental concern has a significant inhibitory effect on corporate greenwashing behaviour. The findings of the study are of great practical significance for enterprises to improve the quality of their environmental information disclosure.
abstract_zh: 环境规制对企业环境、社会与治理（ESG）表现及漂绿行为的影响已成为学术界关注的焦点。本研究基于2007年至2022年A股上市公司的面板数据，从非正式规制视角出发，实证分析了公众环境关注对上市公司ESG表现及漂绿行为的影响。结果表明，公众环境关注显著提升了企业ESG表现，且在滞后一期、系统广义矩估计及两阶段最小二乘回归等稳健性检验后，该结论依然成立。异质性分析显示，公众环境关注对国有企业、非重污染企业及技术密集型企业的ESG表现具有显著正向影响，而对劳动密集型企业的ESG表现则产生显著负向影响。进一步的调节效应结果表明，政府治理与市场约束强化了公众环境关注对企业ESG表现的正向作用。最后，本研究证实公众环境关注对企业漂绿行为具有显著抑制作用。研究结论对于企业提升环境信息披露质量具有重要的实践意义。

title: Market concentration, funding models, and financial stability in developing economies: a comparative analysis using One-Step GMM and Panel Quantile GMM
title_zh: 市场集中度、融资模式与发展中经济体的金融稳定性：基于一步GMM与面板分位数GMM的比较分析
title_primary: 市场集中度、融资模式与发展中经济体的金融稳定性：基于一步GMM与面板分位数GMM的比较分析
title_secondary: Market concentration, funding models, and financial stability in developing economies: a comparative analysis using One-Step GMM and Panel Quantile GMM
authors: Sandra Kendo Jean-Claude Brou a ICL, Junia, Université Catholique de Lille, LITLb ESG Finance, Courbevoie, France
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study aims to investigate the complex relationship between market concentration and financial stability in the microfinance sector, with a particular emphasis on the influence of diverse funding models. Via the use of advanced one-step GMM panel estimation and GMM panel quantile regression, this study effectively addresses endogeneity concerns, thereby examining data from 3,114 MFIs across 123 developing nations from 1999 to 2019. The application of quantile regression provides a nuanced understanding of how the relationship between market concentration and financial stability varies across different levels of insolvency risk, revealing heterogeneous effects often neglected in traditional analyses. Our findings substantiate the concentration‒stability hypothesis, indicating that MFIs in more concentrated markets generally demonstrate enhanced stability. Additionally, the role of funding sources is critical, with savings exerting a greater positive effect on financial stability compared with borrowings. Furthermore, the type of deposits collected is key to understanding the market concentration‒financial stability nexus. MFIs attracting significant volumes of small deposits exhibit a robust positive correlation between market power and stability. Conversely, heightened competition for savings and borrowings may inadvertently amplify insolvency risk, challenging institutional resilience.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨小额信贷行业中市场集中度与金融稳定性之间的复杂关系，特别关注不同融资模式的影响。通过采用先进的一步系统GMM面板估计和GMM面板分位数回归方法，本研究有效解决了内生性问题，并据此分析了1999年至2019年间来自123个发展中国家的3，114家小额信贷机构的数据。分位数回归的应用提供了对市场集中度与金融稳定性之间关系在不同破产风险水平下如何变化的细致理解，揭示了传统分析中常被忽视的异质性效应。我们的研究结果支持了“集中度-稳定性”假说，表明在更为集中的市场中，小额信贷机构通常展现出更强的稳定性。此外，融资来源的作用至关重要，储蓄相较于借款对金融稳定性具有更大的积极影响。进一步而言，所吸收存款的类型是理解市场集中度与金融稳定性关联的关键。吸引大量小额存款的小额信贷机构在市场力量与稳定性之间表现出显著的正相关关系。相反，对储蓄和借款的激烈竞争可能无意中加剧破产风险，对机构的韧性构成挑战。

title: The role of dual-class share structures on managerial self-interest: evidence from US-listed companies
title_zh: 双重股权结构对管理层自利行为的影响：基于美国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 双重股权结构对管理层自利行为的影响：基于美国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: The role of dual-class share structures on managerial self-interest: evidence from US-listed companies
authors: Zhujia Yin Zhimei Xie Jiejin Xia School of Economics and Management, Changsha University of Science & Technology, Changsha, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: By shifting the focus from traditional firm-level outcomes, this study reveals that dual-class share structures significantly exacerbate managerial self-interest. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that this effect is stronger in registered countries with higher corruption levels. The agency effect of dual-class share structures is insignificant for companies in the growth phase, but becomes more pronounced for those in the mature and decline phases. Moderating channel analysis indicates that audit monitoring, stock incentives, sunset clauses, and institutional shareholding can effectively mitigate the managerial self-interest behaviours in dual-class share structures. These findings can be useful references for optimizing dual-class share practice by alleviating its potential agency problems in the field of corporate governance.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过将焦点从传统的企业层面结果转移，揭示出双重股权结构显著加剧了管理层自利行为。异质性分析表明，在腐败程度较高的注册国家，这一效应更为显著。对于处于成长阶段的企业，双重股权结构的代理效应不显著，但在成熟期和衰退期企业中则更为突出。调节渠道分析指出，审计监督、股票激励、日落条款及机构持股能有效缓解双重股权结构下的管理层自利行为。这些发现为优化双重股权实践、减轻其在公司治理领域潜在的代理问题提供了有益参考。

title: Foreign Currency Borrowing of Corporations as Carry Trades: Evidence from India
title_zh: 企业外币借款作为套利交易：来自印度的证据
title_primary: 企业外币借款作为套利交易：来自印度的证据
title_secondary: Foreign Currency Borrowing of Corporations as Carry Trades: Evidence from India
authors: Viral Acharya, Siddharth Vij
official: 官方在线 2020-11-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We establish that macroprudential policies limiting capital flows can curb risks arising from corporate foreign currency borrowing in emerging markets. Using detailed firm- level data from India, we show that propensity to issue foreign currency debt for the same firm is higher when the difference in short-term interest rates between India and the US is higher, i.e., when the dollar ‘carry trade’ is more profitable; this behavior is driven by the period after the global financial crisis. The positive relationship between issuance and the ‘carry trade’ breaks down once regulators institute more stringent interest-rate caps on foreign currency borrowing. Riskier borrowers such as importers and those with higher interest costs cut issuance most. Firm equity exposure to foreign exchange risk rose after issuance in favorable funding conditions and emerged as a source of external sector vulnerability during the ‘taper tantrum’ of 2013. Macroprudential policy action limiting capital flows is able to nullify this effect, such as during the market stress due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
abstract_zh: 我们证实，限制资本流动的宏观审慎政策能够抑制新兴市场企业外币借款所引发的风险。基于印度企业层面的详细数据，研究发现：当印度与美国短期利率差扩大（即美元"套利交易"盈利空间增大）时，同一企业发行外币债务的倾向显著上升——这一行为主要出现在全球金融危机之后。一旦监管机构对外币借款实施更严格的利率上限，发行行为与"套利交易"的正相关关系即告瓦解。进口商及利息成本较高的风险偏好型借款企业降幅最为显著。在有利融资条件下，企业股权的外汇风险敞口随债务发行而扩大，并在2013年"缩减恐慌"期间成为外部脆弱性的来源。限制资本流动的宏观审慎政策能够有效消除此效应，例如在新冠疫情引发的市场压力期间。
